$comment: Paths sitting in a generated OpenAPI document that its generator does not produce.
verify:openapi-drift registers a FILE. Several generators patch only the paths they
own and carry the rest through untouched, so those paths are never regenerated or
compared while the file reports as matching its routes.
THESE COUNTS MAY ONLY SHRINK, and a document not listed here may never gain one.
Shrinking means either giving the remaining paths a generator, or splitting the
document so each half is owned by the route module that produces it.
